sections.title: Project knowledge and local result retrieval

commands.name: project.knowledge.list
commands.description: List explicit project knowledge and suggestions, with Commerce facts remaining owned by the catalog. Reads local records only.

commands.name: project.knowledge.save
commands.description: Save explicitly authorized long-term project knowledge with store and entry CAS. Agent assumptions remain suggestions; this never changes a running task.

commands.name: project.knowledge.status
commands.description: Activate, deactivate or tombstone explicit knowledge using exact revisions. Deleted knowledge cannot be revived by stale saves.

commands.name: project.knowledge.promote
commands.description: Explicitly promote an Agent suggestion to a user project rule; never automatic.

commands.name: project.knowledge.history
commands.description: Read immutable versions of one project rule.

commands.name: project.results.search
commands.description: Search rebuildable local result metadata with combined filters and stable pagination. Prompt intent and user labels are separate from evidence-backed pixel observations. No model request or material/selection mutation.

commands.name: project.results.use
commands.description: Explicitly bind exact current project results into the active composer after authoritative byte and identity validation. Does not generate or expand a running Goal.

commands.name: project.context.get
commands.description: Read this project and conversation knowledge plus the exact historical knowledge used by its last saved task. No model request.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the local authenticated bridge and renderer readiness.

commands.name: app.state
commands.description: Return active project, conversation, Agent status, active run ID, pause state, selection, viewport, node summaries, and recent messages.

commands.name: app.diagnostics
commands.description: Read the last 300 sanitized image/model diagnostic events. No credentials, prompts, media or private paths are returned.

commands.name: app.export-diagnostics
commands.description: Open the native save dialog to export sanitized diagnostic events; the user selects the destination. No destination path is returned.

commands.name: canvas.state
commands.description: Return the active project and local canvas revision, selection, canonical relations, Requirement input bindings and revision/signature, canonical container membership, presentation layout membership, and per-node lock/busy details. Managed asset paths and automation credentials are never returned.

commands.name: image.operations
commands.description: List sanitized image operation stages in the active project. This reads local records and never creates a model request.

commands.name: image.recover
commands.description: Recover an existing image operation by key. Poll only its original task or save its original result; never POST a new generation. Current connection must match. Publishes assets idempotently through the project save owner.

commands.name: creation.requirements.get
commands.description: Read versioned structured goals, usage, deliverable slots, preserve/adjustable rules and acceptance conditions. Sources distinguish user requirements from Agent assumptions. Read-only local operation; no model request.

commands.name: creation.requirements.update
commands.description: Save a complete structured requirements revision with expectedRevision (0 for first creation). Mark every text/slot/criterion source explicitly as user or assumption. At most 400 criteria across the three lists. A stale revision fails before mutation; re-read instead of overwriting. No model request.

commands.name: creation.acceptance.get
commands.description: Read generated, saved, local-file-check, AI-visual-review and user-decision states separately. Stable asset/occurrence/content identities bind evidence to the current requirements revision. Missing or stale evidence never means accepted. No model request.

commands.name: creation.acceptance.check
commands.description: Run deterministic local file/decode/dimension/format/alpha checks for exact existing managed targets and current requirements. This does not perform an AI visual review, create an image or make a model request.

commands.name: creation.acceptance.decide
commands.description: Record the user's adopt/reject/candidate decision for one exact target and current requirements. Adoption requires current saved files and no hard local-check failure; it does not alter or claim an AI review verdict. Re-read stale requirements/evidence before deciding. No model request.

commands.name: creation.revision.start
commands.description: Revise only the exact selected asset/occurrence/content targets using explicit preserve and changes lists. Bind the current requirements revision, retain original files and provenance, and dispatch through the existing durable agent.task.start production chain. Same submissionId/request reuses the receipt; conflicting reuse fails. This can call configured upstream models and requires the user's revision request. Per-target preserve/changes apply only to that identity; top-level lists apply to every selected target. If common changes is empty, each target must provide its own non-empty changes list. For a precise region revision, select exactly one target and optionally provide targets[0].mask as the asset/occurrence/content identity of its saved managed PNG mask. Main verifies project, conversation, target binding and actual bytes, then freezes the mask as a TaskScope material. Arbitrary mask paths, URLs and data URLs are never accepted by this command.

commands.name: agent.task.start
commands.description: Start one asynchronous Agent task in an explicit open project/conversation. Persist the frozen receipt before accepted. Reuse submissionId for retry/reconnect: the same normalized request returns the original task, different content conflicts. Optional requirementId plus expectedRequirementsRevision binds an exact structured requirements revision; pass them together. Omission freezes the current revision on first acceptance and reuses the original revision on reconnect. Busy tasks are never steered. This can call configured upstream models.

commands.name: agent.task.get
commands.description: Read a durable sanitized task receipt, question/options, original image-operation keys and saved asset identities. Supply taskId or submissionId; omitting both returns the latest task in this project/conversation. Works after renderer reload/app restart, never creates a model request.

commands.name: agent.task.wait
commands.description: Wait at most 30000ms for a receipt version change. afterVersion is the last cursor; an older cursor returns the latest snapshot, an ahead/invalidated cursor returns TASK_CURSOR_EXPIRED and requires get. Timeout only ends this wait, returns timedOut plus the original task/cursor, and never stops or restarts work. Receipts/idempotency are retained together without automatic expiry; capacity is fail-closed.

commands.name: agent.task.answer
commands.description: Answer exactly one current structured question using questionId and expectedVersion from get/wait. Choose optionId or supply a custom answer. GUI/CLI compete through the same durable one-use claim. Continues the original frozen TaskScope/configuration and never interprets the answer as an independent image task; source/reference uploads remain the GUI material picker action.

commands.name: debug.runtime-state
commands.description: Return a bounded, redacted Main/Renderer runtime snapshot. Available only in local development or AIDebug mode; it never includes API keys, cookies, endpoint tokens, or absolute user asset paths.

commands.name: debug.renderer-logs
commands.description: Read the most recent bounded Renderer console entries from the local diagnostic log after redaction. Development/AIDebug only.

commands.name: debug.main-logs
commands.description: Read the most recent bounded Main-process diagnostic log after redaction. Development/AIDebug only.

commands.name: debug.run-targeted-test
commands.description: Run one fixed, read-only repository test script and return bounded stdout/stderr. Arbitrary shell, paths, package installs, and user project mutations are not allowed.

commands.name: debug.capture-window
commands.description: Capture the focused SparkAI WorkSpace window into the bounded diagnostic directory. The caller cannot choose an arbitrary path or window.

commands.name: debug.inspect-ipc
commands.description: List registered IPC channel names and counts without exposing handlers, payloads, credentials, or user data.

commands.name: debug.inspect-command
commands.description: Inspect one shared automation command definition, including its surface and parameter schema, without executing it.

commands.name: workspace.domain.list
commands.description: List the four canonical SparkAI workspace domains with their public titles, descriptions, icons, plugin projections, and available tool names.

commands.name: workspace.domain.get
commands.description: Return the active project's current workspace domain. Old projects normalize to general.

commands.name: workspace.domain.set
commands.description: Set the active project's workspace domain without remounting the canvas, clearing selection, interrupting tasks, calling a model, or producing charges.

commands.name: project.list
commands.description: List projects and the active project ID.

commands.name: project.switch
commands.description: Switch to an existing project.

commands.name: project.create
commands.description: Create and activate a project in the requested workspace domain. Optional parentDirectory must be an existing absolute directory; it creates a new uniquely named child folder without a dialog or overwriting existing work. Omit parentDirectory to use the native directory picker. Omitted workspaceDomain inherits the current domain. Cancellation returns canceled=true; creation failures are command errors.

commands.name: project.rename
commands.description: Rename the active project.

commands.name: canvas.select
commands.description: Atomically replace the canvas selection. Every supplied node ID and primaryId must exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails without changing selection. Use an empty ids array to clear selection.

commands.name: canvas.connect
commands.description: Atomically add one or more exact graph edges. Requirement targets accept multiple image inputs and persist inputRole as SOURCE or REFERENCE; ordinary targets keep one parent. Connections never execute a Requirement. Replacing an existing ordinary parent requires replaceExisting=true.

commands.name: canvas.disconnect
commands.description: Atomically remove the exact listed graph edges. Requirement bindings and their primary compatibility parent are recomputed together. If any requested edge is stale or absent, no edge is removed.

commands.name: canvas.group
commands.description: Atomically group an explicit set of compatible image results or containers into one canonical image container. Unsupported, empty, layer, stale, or locked members fail the whole command; no partial subset is grouped.

commands.name: canvas.dissolve
commands.description: Atomically dissolve one or more exact visible image-container hosts, restore their members as independent canvas results, and preserve provenance relations. Any stale or locked container fails the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.nudge
commands.description: Atomically move explicit nodes or visible container hosts by a relative integer offset. Group members are mapped to their host once and locked nodes fail the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.create-requirement
commands.description: Create one reusable Requirement node with an optional explicit ordered SOURCE/REFERENCE input set. Creation never executes the Requirement and commits the node and all bindings together.

commands.name: canvas.update-requirement
commands.description: Atomically update a Requirement title, instructions, or complete ordered input binding set. expectedRevision is a required compare-and-set guard. Editing imported Skill instructions preserves the import fingerprint as source identity and marks the Skill locally modified.

commands.name: canvas.execute-requirement
commands.description: Validate and execute one current Requirement or Skill through the same frozen Requirement TaskScope path as the GUI, then wait for the current Agent turn to settle. A repeated unchanged run requires confirmedUnchanged=true; a busy Agent or stale revision fails before dispatch.

commands.name: canvas.fit
commands.description: Fit current results into view.

commands.name: canvas.clear
commands.description: Clear failed results or, with explicit confirmation, the whole canvas.

commands.name: canvas.delete-selected
commands.description: Delete selected nodes after explicit user authorization.

commands.name: canvas.create-container
commands.description: Create an image container; omit role for a normal container.

commands.name: canvas.import
commands.description: Copy local images into the active project and place them on the canvas.

commands.name: canvas.import-video
commands.description: Copy authorized local MP4, WebM, MOV, or M4V files into the active project and create independent video result nodes. This command imports existing files only; it does not call a video model or incur generation charges.

commands.name: canvas.generate-video
commands.description: Create one durable asynchronous video task through the independent video adapter. The command writes the project journal before provider dispatch, returns the task and canvas-node state without waiting for the video to finish, resumes polling after restart, and never automatically recreates an ambiguous POST. confirmed=true is required because the upstream Base URL or Token may charge for the request.

examples.prompt: Slow orbit around the exact product on a clean studio pedestal.

commands.name: canvas.import-skill
commands.args:
{ "markdown": "---
name: product-photo
description: Product photography guidance
---

Follow these instructions...", "sourceName": "SKILL.md", "x": 240, "y": 180 }
commands.description: Import one bounded SKILL.md document as a reusable Skill-backed requirement node. An unchanged exact re-import selects the existing node. If that node's instructions were edited locally, the response returns exact:false and conflict:locally-modified without overwriting local text.

commands.name: canvas.rename-image-collections
commands.description: Rename one or more current image groups through the shared transactional mutation. Names are NFKC-normalized, Windows-safe, length-limited, and deterministically de-duplicated; node titles, legacy imageCollection, and imageContainerSpec.collection stay synchronized. An explicit rename records manual ownership, including an unchanged name, so later visual naming preserves it after reload.

commands.name: canvas.replace-image-collection-item
commands.description: Replace one or more completed image-group slots with already-managed assets from current canvas nodes. The original remains in an independent defects group; requestIndex, prompt, title and provenance are preserved. The complete batch validates first and is idempotent for the same replacement.

commands.name: canvas.export-image-collections
commands.description: 将图片组加入统一 Main 导出队列，默认保留原文件；返回受理回执，逐项结果通过 export.status 或导出中心查看。

commands.name: canvas.export-image
commands.description: Export one managed canvas image. Defaults to an original byte-for-byte copy at original size; optional PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF/TIFF conversion is local. The native Save dialog grants the selected delivery location; command JSON never accepts a write path. JPEG flattens alpha on white. Source bytes remain unchanged.

commands.name: export.authorize-directory
commands.description: Open one native directory picker for the active project. Main holds the directory and returns an opaque authorizationId; no caller-supplied write path is accepted.

commands.name: export.start
commands.description: Freeze and enqueue image, collection transaction, or PSD export in Main. Folder or atomic ZIP, one authorized target, original bytes/size by default. Collection preflight is performed before enqueue. No arbitrary write paths.

commands.name: export.status
commands.description: Read Main queue and item results, or list current-project jobs and persisted receipts. Interrupted historical jobs are never automatically restarted.

commands.name: export.cancel
commands.description: Cancel this export between item commits. Completed loose files remain and are reported. No other export is cancelled.

commands.name: export.retry-failed
commands.description: Retry only failed items in an existing live Main queue, preserving successful results and the original hashes, target authorization and parameters. Does not reconstruct jobs after restart.

commands.name: requirement-library.list
commands.description: List the installation-local personal Requirement template library across projects. By default the response contains bounded summaries; includeText=true returns the complete stored instructions. Every library item still instantiates as a normal Requirement node, including items carrying Skill metadata.

commands.name: requirement-library.save
commands.description: Explicitly save one current Requirement or one completed saved task as a reusable personal template. Choose nodeId + expectedRequirementRevision, or taskId + conversationId + expectedRequirementsRevision; expectedProjectId guards the current project. Template v2 contains finite declarative variables and reusable checks, never source assets, task receipts or credentials. Omit templateId for a new item; overwrite requires its exact expectedTemplateRevision. This local operation makes no model request.

default.description: A bounded string or finite number matching the variable type; image variables cannot have defaults.

acceptance.description: Reusable phase-two requirements draft. Source-consistency conditions refer to declared image variable names through sourceVariables. Instance identities are never portable.

commands.name: requirement-library.delete
commands.description: Delete one personal Requirement template only when its exact revision is still current and confirmed=true. This does not delete any Requirement nodes already instantiated on project canvases.

commands.name: requirement-library.use
commands.description: Instantiate one exact personal template revision on the active canvas as a normal Requirement node. variableValues expand finite text/enum/number placeholders; imageBindings bind declared image keys only to current-project node IDs. Missing image declarations remain a draft and block execution until bound. Current image settings remain authoritative. Optional SOURCE/REFERENCE bindings and position use the existing graph/project/canvas guards. This command never executes the Requirement, never calls an image model, and never spends image quota.

variableValues.description: At most 24 declared keys with bounded string or finite number values, validated by the template owner.

commands.name: requirement-library.import
commands.description: Import a strict portable v1/v2 Requirement template through the existing native file picker. No arbitrary file path is accepted and no model request occurs.

commands.name: requirement-library.export
commands.description: Export one exact personal template revision through the native Save picker. The portable document omits instance identities, paths, credentials and bound sources. No destination path is accepted.

commands.name: commerce.template.list
commands.description: List the installation-local commerce template market. Built-in Amazon and AliExpress entries are read-only; personal entries include exact revisions for compare-and-set updates, export, and deletion. This command does not require a canvas selection and never generates images.

commands.name: commerce.template.save
commands.description: Save a reusable structured commerce set plan to the installation-local template market. Omit templateId for a new personal template. A same-name create fails with TEMPLATE_NAME_CONFLICT instead of silently overwriting; use conflictPolicy=copy to create an automatically numbered copy, or re-read the library and pass conflictPolicy=overwrite with the exact personal templateId and expectedTemplateRevision. Source-specific translationItems and canvas saveTarget state are intentionally not accepted or persisted.

commands.name: commerce.template.delete
commands.description: Delete one exact personal commerce template revision. confirmed=true is required. Built-in templates, existing canvas nodes, generated images, and catalog relations are never deleted.

commands.name: commerce.template.import
commands.description: Open the native file picker and import one strict naimage-commerce-template v1 JSON document as a new personal template. Unknown fields, oversized files, invalid plans, and silent overwrites are rejected.

commands.name: commerce.template.export
commands.description: Export one built-in or personal commerce template through the native save dialog. Personal templates require the exact displayed revision; the portable file excludes local IDs, timestamps, source-specific translation cells, canvas paths, and saveTarget state.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.list
commands.description: Read the project-local SKU product catalog with its aggregate CAS revision. The response includes products, variants, SKUs and portable asset relations, but never absolute paths, URLs, blobs or image data.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.upsert
commands.description: Create or update one product aggregate through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. Variant and SKU IDs are Main-owned stable identities; omit them only when creating a new row. An enabled brandStyle is frozen into future Commerce Goals whose SOURCE resolves to this product/SKU; linked logo, packaging and style-reference assets are selected from commerce.catalog.assign records at Goal preview time. This command performs no image generation and never changes canvas nodes.

brandStyle.logoUsage: Keep the original logo artwork, wording, colors and proportions.
brandStyle.modelAppearance: Use the same adult model identity across the listing set.
brandStyle.productAppearance: Keep body geometry, finish and printed markings unchanged.
brandStyle.visualStyle: Clean premium product photography with restrained typography.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.delete
commands.description: Archive one exact product revision. This never deletes canvas nodes or image files and performs no implicit cascade. confirmed=true is still required because the product disappears from the default active catalog view.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.assign
commands.description: Atomically associate 1-200 authoritative canvas images with a product, variant or SKU as a mother image, brand asset or generated result. Inputs accept only nodeId plus zero-based assetIndex; Main resolves managed asset identity and rejects stale, unfinished, unmanaged or path-like input before writing.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.remove
commands.description: Remove one exact material or result relation through catalog and product CAS guards. The underlying canvas node and managed image file are retained.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.review
commands.description: Review one or more generated catalog results through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. linkIds are processed in order against the evolving revisions and may be marked candidate, approved, or rejected; this changes only review state and retains canvas nodes and managed image files.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.compare
commands.description: List A/B comparison groups for retained results sharing the same product ownership, source relation, slot, locale, and role. Different commerce plan runs remain comparable. Groups contain at least two distinct result payloads and preserve exact catalog/product revisions for final selection.

commands.name: commerce.catalog.select
commands.description: Atomically select one exact A/B winner through catalog and product compare-and-set guards. The winner becomes approved and every retained sibling in the recomputed comparison group becomes rejected in one catalog write. No relation, provenance record, canvas node, or managed image file is deleted.

commands.name: commerce.export.preview
commands.description: Preview an Amazon or AliExpress export from the authoritative project SKU catalog. Product-level results inherit to every selected SKU, variant-level results inherit only to matching SKUs, and SKU-level results remain local. Approved results are included by default; includeCandidates=true also includes candidates, while rejected results are always excluded. The response reports dimensions, aspect ratio, Amazon main-image white-edge checks, stable SKU filenames, package counts, and integrity blockers without exposing source paths or writing files.

commands.name: commerce.export.package
commands.description: Re-run the authoritative platform checks and export the selected SKU packages plus a relative-path manifest through a native directory picker. confirmed=true is mandatory. The command never accepts a caller-provided destination path, never mutates managed source images, blocks missing or hash-mismatched assets, and publishes the completed directory atomically.

commands.name: social.xiaohongshu.plan
commands.description: Create a structured Xiaohongshu Requirement on the current canvas without calling a model or producing charges. The optional SOURCE nodes are exact and atomically checked against the active project and canvas revision.

examples.brief: 制作一组适合小红书发布的通勤防晒经验图文

commands.name: social.xiaohongshu.execute
commands.description: Execute one existing Xiaohongshu social Requirement through the production Agent and image task path, then wait for the current turn to settle. This explicit command authorizes the planned image requests and possible upstream billing; the response reports planned request counts and observed dispatch state.

commands.name: social.xiaohongshu.export
commands.description: Export one Xiaohongshu publish package through the native directory picker after rechecking project, Requirement revision, workflow identity and managed assets. confirmed=true is mandatory; no caller-provided destination path is accepted.

commands.name: social.douyin.plan
commands.description: Create a structured Douyin short-video Requirement on the current canvas without calling a model or producing charges. The optional SOURCE nodes are exact and atomically checked against the active project and canvas revision.

examples.brief: 制作一条新品咖啡杯展示短视频

commands.name: social.douyin.execute
commands.description: Execute one existing Douyin social Requirement through the production Agent, image tasks and independent video task journal, then wait for the current Agent turn to settle. This explicit command authorizes the planned image and video requests and possible upstream billing. Ambiguous video creation is reported and never retried automatically.

commands.name: social.douyin.status
commands.description: Inspect one Douyin Requirement and its sanitized image/video outcomes, including video task state and ambiguous creation, without exposing managed paths, provider URLs or credentials.

commands.name: social.douyin.export
commands.description: Export one Douyin publish package through the native directory picker after rechecking project, Requirement revision, workflow identity and managed images/video. confirmed=true is mandatory; no caller-provided destination path is accepted.

commands.name: research.data.import
commands.description: Open the native file picker and import one CSV, TSV, or TXT dataset into the active project's managed scientific data registry. The CLI cannot pass an arbitrary source path; Renderer receives only bounded fields, dimensions, hashes, and sample rows.

commands.name: research.data.list
commands.description: List sanitized managed scientific datasets for the active project. Absolute paths and full table contents are never returned.

commands.name: research.figure.plan
commands.description: Create a structured ScientificFigurePlan as a Requirement on the existing canvas. This does not execute Python/R, call a model, or produce charges. A persisted plan must explicitly select one backend and may reference only managed dataSourceIds returned by research.data.list.

examples.researchClaim: 处理组随时间呈现更高的测量值，不在此处推断显著性。

commands.name: research.figure.render
commands.description: Execute one exact scientific Requirement through the trusted project-scoped Python/R runner, then land its PNG figure and Panel previews on the existing canvas. The command validates project, canvas and Requirement revisions, never switches backend, never installs dependencies, never accesses model billing, and returns script/output/status metadata.

commands.name: research.figure.status
commands.description: Inspect sanitized scientific tasks for the active project, optionally filtering by taskId or scientific Requirement nodeId. Managed absolute paths and full logs are not returned.

commands.name: research.figure.export
commands.description: Export one ready scientific task through the native directory picker. confirmed=true is mandatory; callers cannot provide a destination path. PNG/TIFF/SVG/PDF, trusted script, plan, QA, and bounded log assets are copied together.

commands.name: research.figure.cancel
commands.description: Cancel one prepared or running local scientific task. Existing managed data and completed output assets are retained; confirmed=true is required.

commands.name: agent.add-canvas-materials
commands.description: Add existing canvas images to the current composer SOURCE or REFERENCE list without calling the Agent or generating images. Omit assetIndex to add all completed images of a node/container, or provide a zero-based member index. Explicit role replaces the other role for the same occurrence; duplicates do not add slots. Project and optional canvas revision guards validate the entire target list before mutation. Existing canvas identity and provenance are reused, and capacity omissions are reported.

commands.name: agent.chat
commands.description: Start an idle task and wait for its current Agent turn to settle. Optional ratio/resolution fields add an explicit image output specification to the instruction. While a task is already running, this command performs a text-only steer with the frozen TaskScope kept unchanged and returns after acceptance; sourceNodeIds are then rejected and explicit attachment changes must use agent.steer. Every supplied sourceNodeId must still exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails before any Agent call.

examples.prompt: 生成一张 Amazon 商品主图

commands.name: agent.goal
commands.description: Execute a Goal across either the exact sourceNodeIds or, when omitted, all eligible SOURCE image containers. Optional ratio/resolution fields add one explicit output specification for every generated image. Invoking this command is explicit authorization to dispatch image requests and accept upstream billing; no second fee confirmation is requested. operationsPerAsset freezes the number of requested operations for every eligible source asset. Before dispatch, naimage internally builds the complete preview, TaskScope and billing quote, issues and consumes a one-time authorization receipt, and rechecks canvas drift. Empty, generating, stale, reference-only, changed, or busy inputs fail before provider dispatch. The result includes the frozen request count, billing estimate, probe count, and concurrency cap, and the command waits for the current Agent turn to settle.

examples.prompt: 为每张母图生成两张方形商品图

commands.name: commerce.compose-set
commands.description: Compose and execute a deterministic cross-border commerce listing-set plan. platformTemplateId selects the built-in general, amazon, or aliexpress slot registry; explicit slots may then override the selected template one image at a time. In translate mode, translationItems applies a non-empty prompt to one exact zero-based sourceIndex and selected localeCode cell; duplicate, unselected, or out-of-range cells fail before dispatch. Invoking this command is explicit authorization to dispatch the resulting image requests and accept upstream billing; no second fee confirmation is requested. sourceNodeIds are exact and atomic, and the plan determines operationsPerAsset. naimage normalizes the plan, builds the complete frozen Goal preview, TaskScope and billing quote, then internally issues and consumes the same one-time authorization receipt used by agent.goal before dispatch. When a SOURCE mother image has one unambiguous active master relation in the project SKU catalog, that binding is frozen into the TaskScope and successful results are automatically filed to the matching product, variant, or SKU after the session is saved; ambiguous or changed catalog ownership is reported without deleting the generated images. The dispatch response includes frozen request, billing, probe, and concurrency metadata. Probe-first admission, progressive ramp-up, circuit protection, and duplicate-dispatch protection remain mandatory.

slots.title: 商品首图

slots.prompt: 展示来源中真实可见的结构和材质细节，不虚构规格或功效。

plan.title: Localized marketplace listing set

targetLocales.prompt: Use concise US marketplace wording and preserve brand names, model numbers, numbers, and units.
Use natural concise Japanese commerce wording with readable line breaks and hierarchy.

plan.translatePrompt: Translate only text that is visibly present and preserve the product, layout intent, trademarks, and factual claims.

translationItems.prompt: Translate the top headline only; preserve the dimensions table and unit labels.

commands.name: agent.steer
commands.description: Change the active task, independently keep, replace, append, or clear SOURCE/REFERENCE attachments, persist a re-hashed TaskScope snapshot, interrupt the current phase, and return only after acceptance. sourceMode/referenceMode override the compatible taskScopeMode shorthand. Every supplied node ID must exist; replace/merge requires a non-empty corresponding ID list and never executes a valid subset of a stale request.

commands.name: agent.pause
commands.description: Pause dispatch at the next runtime boundary; an accepted upstream request may still finish.

commands.name: agent.resume
commands.description: Resume a paused task and fail the command if the runtime does not accept the resume.

commands.name: agent.stop
commands.description: Stop the active task while preserving completed results. Missing active work or a failed backend cancellation is a top-level command failure, never a successful idle response.

commands.name: agent.image-config
commands.description: Open the shared image configuration dialog; does not dispatch any model or image request. Edit and persist model pool/default, ratio, resolution, count and quality through the same GUI owner.

commands.name: agent.new-conversation
commands.description: Start a conversation without clearing canvas results.

sections.title: Portable projects, AI edit and local ComfyUI

commands.name: comfyui.templates
commands.description: List locally reviewed API JSON templates and their input/output mappings. No model request.

commands.name: comfyui.inspect
commands.description: Inspect only the existing localhost ComfyUI system_stats/object_info; never install software or weights.

commands.name: comfyui.import-template
commands.description: Open native JSON picker, validate API Format JSON against reviewed core nodes and explicit mappings, and persist template. No execution.

commands.name: comfyui.generate
commands.description: Explicitly execute one reviewed local image_gen template. Freeze actual seed/model/inputs/workflow; submissionId is durable, same content recovers and conflicting content is rejected. Local service execution requires current user authorization.

commands.name: comfyui.cancel
commands.description: Cancel only a verified queued prompt belonging to this journal entry. Running cancellation fails unless directional interruption is verified; never global interrupt.

commands.name: canvas.edit-image
commands.description: Open the existing AI image editor for one exact canvas image. Modes share image_gen; no generation occurs until explicit submit. Expand is unavailable.

commands.name: project.package-export
commands.description: Flush project and open native .naimage destination picker. Share includes canvas/assets/catalog; archive additionally includes knowledge and optional historical conversations. Original media bytes retain metadata. No arbitrary destination path.

commands.name: project.package-import
commands.description: Import through native file and parent directory pickers. Validate legacy JSON/v4 ZIP and create a new project identity with historical execution permissions removed.

notes.title: Composer slash commands
notes.body: GUI and detached Agent share /goal <prompt>, /config, /status, /help, /new, /pause, /resume and /stop. They execute locally; unknown or incomplete commands never reach a model. /goal retains scope and fee confirmation, and active Goals only permit text steering. CLI/MCP should use structured agent.goal, agent.image-config, app.state, agent.new-conversation, agent.pause, agent.resume and agent.stop actions instead of passing slash commands to agent.chat.

notes.title: Images and containers
notes.body: For generation, editing, variants, cutout, redraw, and layer work, select the intended sources and use `agent.chat`. The Agent preserves provenance and creates results through the same runtime as the GUI.

notes.title: Frozen image configuration
notes.body: A newly dispatched task internally freezes the selected image model pool, model capabilities, ratio, resolution, quality, count and output format in its TaskScope. Ask User replies, reloads and attachment steering preserve that configuration; settings edits apply to a new task. An explicit attachment change re-hashes the material scope without adopting a new image configuration. A Goal also binds this configuration before issuing its one-time confirmation and permits only text steering. Historical node imageParams describe earlier images and never override the current request configuration. Credentials and connection addresses are resolved by Main and are excluded from the frozen snapshot; CLI/MCP callers cannot inject a TaskScope or credentials.

notes.title: Visual content names
notes.body: Use agent.chat with the intended canvas node IDs when the user requests content inspection or naming. The internal Agent may submit workflow.update_node.visualName only after a subsequent successful model round consumes the view_image pixels in the same turn; this managed path is an internal runtime argument, not a public CLI/MCP field. Explicit manual node and asset titles retain ownership after reload, including generic titles and numeric suffixes. Use canvas.rename-image-collections for an explicit manual collection name. Neither naming path starts an image generation request.

notes.title: Responses and errors
notes.body: Successful output is JSON with `ok: true` and `result`. Failures use `ok: false` and `error`. Retry a `rendererReady: false` status briefly. Never expose endpoint authorization data.

notes.title: Renderer lifecycle
notes.body: Every Agent run and pending automation command is owned by the Renderer that dispatched it. If that Renderer closes or crashes, naimage immediately rejects its pending CLI commands, aborts its run, and prevents further dispatch without affecting other Renderer owners. Provider requests already accepted upstream continue draining under Main-process admission and may still complete or incur charges. Application shutdown aborts all runs before transports are dismantled.

notes.title: Goal dispatch safety
notes.body: An explicit agent.goal or commerce.compose-set invocation authorizes upstream image charges. The Renderer still builds a complete preview and cryptographically random one-time receipt bound to the full request, frozen TaskScope, billing quote, active project, conversation, and issuing surface, then consumes it internally before dispatch. Changed inputs, stale scopes, changed costs, cancellation, and replay are rejected before provider dispatch. Goal execution uses the app's configured concurrency limit, but first serially probes 1-2 distinct SOURCE images, preferring different containers when available. Renderer windows share one Main-process Goal admission controller: queued probes take priority over new ramp waves, and admitted Goals fairly share the frozen process capacity. The app expands only after request acceptance, asset persistence, and result validation succeed; protected failures open a cross-Goal circuit. A bounded transport retry pauses every new ramp wave until the request settles, and closing a Renderer does not release its reservation until the real provider Promise drains. These safeguards stop only work that has not yet been dispatched. An upstream request already accepted by a provider may still complete and incur charges, so process-wide admission is not a cost guarantee.

notes.title: Commerce plan contract
notes.body: For commerce.compose-set, languageCodes and targetLocales are mutually exclusive and every language code must come from the canonical commerce language registry. Unknown languages or supplying both fields fails before plugin composition, the internal Goal preview, or provider dispatch. TranslationItems uses the exact SOURCE expansion order and may override only a selected image-language cell; its normalized prompts are included in the frozen plan hash and prompt-material fingerprint. The structured plan, exact SOURCE boundary, and any unambiguous project SKU Catalog destination are frozen into the one-time internal authorization receipt and cannot be changed after dispatch begins. Successful results are reconciled from the persisted session into the frozen product, variant, or SKU target; ambiguous ownership or a Catalog revision conflict leaves the image on the canvas and returns a retry/manual-filing warning.
